clips.label: The Glass Tide · 30 seconds
clips.note: From the crimson reef through a suspended glass city to a wider rolling reveal.
clips.details: The original opening continues through blue-and-ivory arches, emerald inlays and amber coral. Sideways travel, banks, local curls, perspective turns and a closing pullback overlap without cuts. All 270 paintings are retained at 1536×1024 and 24 fps. Krea 2 Turbo, Euler, noise 0.72, three updates, CFG1; warped-previous feedback, additional reference conditioning off. RIFE stays outside feedback. Fine ribs and glass edges remain clear, while broad pale surfaces are smoother. The original eight-second cut remains available.
